querySql:
select 
                                      id,
                                      report_id,
                                      stock_code,
                                      stock_name,
                                      title,
                                      report_type,
                                      organ_id,
                                      organ_name,
                                      author,
                                      report_year,
                                      current_create_date,
                                      previous_create_date,
                                      current_forecast_np,
                                      previous_forecast_np,
                                      np_adjust_rate,
                                      np_adjust_mark,
                                      current_forecast_eps,
                                      previous_forecast_eps,
                                      eps_adjust_rate,
                                      eps_adjust_mark,
                                      is_capital_different,
                                      entrytime,
                                      updatetime,
                                      tmstamp,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'zyyx_rpt_earnings_adjust.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.rpt_earnings_adjust WHERE current_create_date BETWEEN '${beg_date}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${beg_date}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
